# what-am-i-missing

> Open-source Agent Skill (SKILL.md) for Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex, Cursor and other AI agents. It performs gap analysis on a plan, brief, design doc or launch checklist against named laws, standards, frameworks and market benchmarks. Each finding cites its source, marks it as web-verified (✅) or recalled from memory (🧠), and gives the cheapest next check. A premortem pass adds the hidden assumption. Triggers on "what am I missing", "blind spots", "gaps" and "o que estou esquecendo".

## Files
- [SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WednyFernandes/what-am-i-missing/main/skills/what-am-i-missing/SKILL.md): the skill itself (process, output format, verification rule, reference sets)
- [README](https://github.com/WednyFernandes/what-am-i-missing/blob/main/README.md): install, usage, comparison, FAQ
- [Example report](https://github.com/WednyFernandes/what-am-i-missing/blob/main/examples/roblox-fishing-simulator.md): full sample output for a Roblox simulator GDD

## Install
- Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace add WednyFernandes/what-am-i-missing`, then `/plugin install what-am-i-missing@what-am-i-missing`
- Any agent: `npx skills add WednyFernandes/what-am-i-missing`
- Manual: copy SKILL.md to `~/.claude/skills/what-am-i-missing/SKILL.md`

## Key facts
- Two modes: global (whole project or plan, coverage-by-area table, up to 7 findings) and focused (one question or area such as `foco: segurança`, deeper references, up to 10 findings). Findings are never padded.
- Output: reading, references used, already covered, findings (severity, consequence, source ✅ verified / 🧠 memory, cheapest check), hidden assumption, can-wait list, recommendations table (add / change / remove / pivot), start with, sources. Section names are translated into the user's language.
- A pivot is recommended only with verified evidence against the hidden assumption. With only remembered evidence it is conditional.
- It respects the user's brevity limits, handles vague ideas, solid plans, no-web runs and non-Brazil jurisdictions, and never invents norm numbers
